title: Building VectorMind During My Data Science Internship at Codec Technologies
excerpt: Reflections on developing a natural-language sales analytics and forecasting platform during a remote Data Science internship.

blocks.content: From May to June 2025, I worked as a remote Data Science Intern at Codec Technologies Pvt. Ltd. During this period, my primary responsibility was contributing to the development of VectorMind, an internal sales-analytics platform.

VectorMind was designed to help non-technical stakeholders interrogate enterprise sales datasets effortlessly. Its core functions include:

• Explaining sales trends across quarters
• Generating future sales forecasts from historical patterns
• Answering natural-language questions about commercial data
• Visualizing breakdowns through an interactive Streamlit interface

blocks.text: VectorMind: a sales-analytics platform built during a Data Science internship at Codec Technologies Pvt. Ltd (May–Jun 2025, Remote). It explains trends, forecasts sales, and answers natural-language questions about sales data.
blocks.author: Verified Project Scope

blocks.content: Working on VectorMind emphasized the importance of data sanity and conversational clarity. In commercial analytics, providing an accurate, grounded answer with clear boundaries is far more valuable than speculative forecasting.
